details: The cryptocurrency market is experiencing a significant downturn, with Bitcoin trading near $75,500 and heading for its fifth consecutive weekly loss. This bearish trend is primarily driven by a broader "risk-off" sentiment in global financial markets, a sharp sell-off in US technology stocks, and sustained outflows from US-listed Bitcoin spot Exchange Traded Funds (ETFs). The market saw a wave of liquidations, intensifying the downward pressure.
title: Crypto Market Plunges Amid Tech Sell-Off & ETF Outflows

details: Binance's Chief Financial Officer, Kaiser Ng, has resigned in the aftermath of the recent $6.3 billion hack on the exchange, though Binance stated the transition was planned. Separately, crypto-linked Visa debit card provider Gnosis Pay disclosed a security breach that exposed sensitive customer information, including payment card details, home addresses, and cryptocurrency wallet addresses. While Gnosis Pay stated customer funds were unaffected, the incident raises concerns about data security.
title: Binance CFO Resigns Post-Hack; Gnosis Pay Suffers Data Breach

details: The highly anticipated Glamsterdam upgrade for Ethereum has been postponed from its planned activation on the Hoodi testnet. The delay comes after blockchain security firm Chainsecurity identified potential gas-related security risks that could make some smart contracts vulnerable following the implementation of certain proposals (EIP-8037 and EIP-8038). Developers are now taking additional time to resolve these issues before proceeding.
title: Ethereum's Glamsterdam Upgrade Delayed Due to Security Risks

details: Following the Democratic party's sweeping victory in the US midterm elections, which secured them control of both the House and Senate, concerns are growing within the crypto industry about a shift towards potentially stricter regulatory oversight. Discussions are reportedly underway to revisit crypto market structure proposals, which could expand the Securities and Exchange Commission's (SEC) authority over crypto markets and introduce new ethics restrictions for federal officials involved with cryptocurrencies.
title: US Midterm Elections Spark Fears of Stricter Crypto Regulation
